name: Put Unit Pricing Matrix
description: Manage the rent pricing structure for a specific unit

pathParams.name: UnitId
pathParams.description: Unique identifier of the unit associated with the rent pricing matrix entry

attributes.name: PricingMatrix
attributes.description: Array of objects that defines the rent pricing structure and lease terms for a unit

attributes.name: StartDate
attributes.description: The date when the specific rent price becomes effective for the unit

attributes.name: Price
attributes.description: The monthly rent amount for the unit

attributes.name: ExpirationDate
attributes.description: The date when the specific rent price expires for the unit

attributes.name: LeaseTerm
attributes.description: The number of months for which the specified rent price applies

responseFields.name: Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the unit associated with the rent pricing matrix entry
